# `pacvamp tools list`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp tools list [-c --channel <CHANNEL>] [--all] <TOOL>`

List vetted versions of a tool, oldest first

## Arguments
- **`<TOOL>`**

## Flags
- **`-c --channel <CHANNEL>`** — Only versions in this channel: edge, rc, or stable
- **`--all`** — Include held versions
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
